item.title: NSPP plasma-water graphene oxide
item.description:
Evidence: Well-supported for the lab method (peer-reviewed). Cost, tonne-scale, and “replaces graphite” claims are Preliminary. The 1 Oct 2026 Chemical Engineering item is a recurrence of a paper accepted February 2026.

Related notes: [[guides/glossary|NSPP]] · [[topics/health/form-route|GO]] · [[reference/production]]

Five facts

  1. Banavath et al. grow graphene oxide at a methane–water interface with a non-thermal atmospheric nanosecond pulsed plasma (NSPP). No mined graphite, no Hummers acids.
  2. Journal: Nature Communications, DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-69831-0. Received 9 Aug 2025, accepted 9 Feb 2026. Texas A&M plus LTEOIL (College Station).
  3. Reported lab rate: a four-gap reactor up to about 5 g GO per day. That is a bench scale-up, not a plant.
  4. Hydrogen is the co-product. The project started as a hydrogen effort; carbon sheets were the unexpected high-value solid.
  5. Trade coverage on 1 Oct 2026 (Chemical Engineering) restates the July 2026 university release. It is not a new experiment.

What the process is

Conventional GO starts with graphite, oxidizes it (Brodie, Staudenmaier, Hummers and variants), then exfoliates. That route needs concentrated acids and leaves a waste stream.

item.title: Black Swan Graphene (Consett)
item.description:
Evidence: company news and MD&A. Not a rating. Not advice.

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

What it is

Black Swan Graphene Inc. (TSXV SWAN, OTCQX BSWGF). Formed 2021 from Mason Graphite + Thomas Swan IP in company copy. Toronto office; production at Thomas Swan, Consett, United Kingdom.

Process language: patented processing / high-pressure homogenization (GEA Ariete class in the 2025 expansion notice) — platelet / dispersion family, not a Cu-CVD mill.

Capacity the company states

  • Pre-expansion: up to 40 t/year.
  • 3 Jun 2025 order: next unit to take the Consett line to 140 t/year. Graphene-Info later (Jul 2025) says that expansion completed.
  • 2023 scoping study talk of a much larger Québec plant (MD&A cites an initial target near 9,868 t/year) is a study, not a built mill. Do not file Québec as operating.

How to read it

40 → 140 t at Consett is a company scale-up at an existing UK site. It is not 4,000 t GrapheneBlack and not a 2004 flake foundry.

CHARMGRAPHENE Co., Ltd. History page: established Aug 2010; name change and move to Suwon Mar 2019.

What they say they run

  • Company history: 2019 high-speed R2R 300 mm, 1 m/min; 2024 Oct setup of wider tool — Cu 6 µm, width 600 mm, 1 m²/min in their wording, plus “world’s largest-width” — company claim.
  • Heaters, shielding tape, EUV pellicle language (2023, 144×110 mm, 7 nm, 94% T) — company history, not a foundry qualification sheet.

Film and gadgets. Not a 4,000 t powder mill.

item.title: CVD Equipment Corp. (Central Islip)

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

CVD Equipment Corporation. 355 South Technology Drive, Central Islip, New York 11722. Founded 1982 in directories. NASDAQ CVV.

What it is

Designs and builds CVD / thermal process tools and gas systems used by other people to grow graphene, SiC, CNTs, TMDCs. Application lab, not a GrapheneBlack tote. File next to Graphenea’s tool-using film line, not next to Sixth Element’s GO tanks.

item.title: Directa Plus — G+ production
item.description:
Evidence: Documented public company (AIM DCTA) with a named product family. Exact line capacity varies by year’s report — read the filing, do not copy a slide.

Parent list: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

Site

Lomazzo area, Italy, is the usual production address in company materials. Confirm the current annual report before quoting floor area or t/year.

Product family

G+ graphene used in:

  • textile finishes
  • environmental / water and soil products in company catalogues
  • other masterbatch and compound SKUs when listed that year

How to cite

Prefer the AIM annual report or RNS over a third-party “380 company” directory. Capacity claims in trade PDFs are Unverified until the RNS number is attached.

item.title: Graphenea — CVD films and GO lots

San Sebastián (Spain) and a US shop (Boston area in company copy) for films and oxide.

Products

item.title: Haydale — functionalization and heating goods
item.description:
Evidence: Documented AIM issuer. Process (plasma functionalization) is the company’s long-standing claim. 2026 rename appears in trade copy — check the RNS.

Ticker historically AIM HAYD. Parent list: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

What they sell

  • Functionalized graphene / carbon powders (plasma process).
  • Finished heating goods (JustHeat-class panels in 2026 roundups).

Sites

UK process shops (Ammanford often named in older copy). Always pair a site name with the year of the report.

What this is not

Not a commodity 1,000 t powder mill. A heating panel is a downstream product, not extra flake capacity.

item.title: HydroGraph (Manhattan, KS)
item.description:

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

HydroGraph Clean Power. Vancouver office. Production: 809 Levee Dr #H, Manhattan, KS 66502. ~13,000 sq ft plant language from the 2022 opening note. Process: licensed KSU detonation / “explosion synthesis”; Hyperion reactors (~6×6×18 ft in the 2026 scale-up note).

Sparc coatings tests belong on the order row, not here.

item.title: NanoXplore — Saint-Laurent plant
item.description:
Evidence: Documented that the company names this site and a 4,000 t/year rating. Documented that later earnings calls also say “up to 5,000.” Utilization is not independently audited here.

Ticker: TSX GRA / OTCQX NNXPF. Parent list: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

Site

  • Saint-Laurent, Montréal, Québec.
  • Company copy (2020 onward): industrial GrapheneBlack powder line sized for 4,000 metric tons per year.
  • Q4 FY2026 results page (15 Sep 2026): still “4,000 metric tons of annual production capacity in Montreal.”
  • Same week’s earnings call language: “up to 5,000 tons of annual capacity.” Treat the extra thousand as company-stated, not a second audited mill.

What they say they make

  • GrapheneBlack powder (X-series high aspect ratio; D-series high surface area announced for later commercial lots).
  • Graphene-enhanced plastics and composites sold downstream.
  • Separate battery-materials talk (VoltaXplore / silicon-graphene) is not the same as the powder mill.

What this is not

Not 4,000 t of CVD monolayer. Not a graphite mine. Capacity ≠ shipments.

item.title: Pacific Urethanes (Dandenong South)
item.description:
Evidence: FGR 9 Sep 2026 production-order release. Fire class is unpublished — Preliminary gap, not a hidden UL 94.

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]] · [[topics/manufacturing/first-graphene-henderson]] · [[topics/industry/2026-09-10-first-graphene-pacific-urethanes]] · [[reference/applications]]

Site

Pacific Urethanes Pty Ltd. 2–10 Produce Drive, Dandenong South, VIC 3175. HQ here from 1 Sep 2019 in their note. They formulate PU. They do not grow graphene.

Graphene step

9 Sep 2026 — first FGR production PO of PureGRAPH into mining-sector PU as a fire-retardancy helper, wear kept. FGR list of PU already in a mine: liners, screens, slurry, conveyors, seals, coats. Stated mechanism: planar barrier + char; used with non-halogenated FR at lower loading (Armstrong / Proactive). ~Two years of customer work before the PO.

item.title: Plants and products
item.description:
Who runs a line, and what leaves it. What ships as a coat, panel, or filter is on [[reference/applications]]. East Asia list: [[topics/manufacturing/east-asia]].

Public powder / additive

  • [[topics/manufacturing/nanoxplore-saint-laurent|NanoXplore, Saint-Laurent]] — GrapheneBlack. Company 4,000 t class. TSX GRA.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/first-graphene-henderson|First Graphene, Henderson]] — PureGRAPH. Company up to 100 t. ASX FGR.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/directa-plus|Directa Plus, Lomazzo]] — G+. AIM DCTA.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/haydale|Haydale]] — plasma + heating goods. AIM HAYD.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/gmg|GMG]] — plasma graphene. TSXV GMG.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/black-swan-consett|Black Swan, Consett]] — 40 → 140 t GNP. TSXV SWAN.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/thomas-swan|Thomas Swan, Consett]] — landlord + 2014 GNP heritage. Do not double-count with Black Swan.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/hydrograph|HydroGraph, Manhattan KS]] — ~10 t per Hyperion reactor.

Film / GO / flash

  • [[topics/manufacturing/graphenea|Graphenea]] — San Sebastián / Boston CVD + GO.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/2d-carbon|2D Carbon, Changzhou]] — CVD film. NEEQ 833608.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/graphene-square|Graphene Square, Pohang]] — CVD film, 2025 plant.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/charmgraphene|Charmgraphene, Suwon]] — R2R CVD.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/moxi|Chongqing Moxi]] — CVD sheets; size unpublished.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/universal-matter|Universal Matter]] — flash Joule; Burlington / Houston / Redcar (ex-AGM).

East Asia powder / catalogue

  • [[topics/manufacturing/sixth-element|Sixth Element, Changzhou]] — NEEQ 831190.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/knano|Knano, Xiamen]] — ≥500 t company-stated.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/xfnano|XFNANO, Nanjing]] — catalogue + Pukou plant.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/leadernano|LeaderNano, Jining]] — small 2015 line in old copy.

US early / chemistry

  • [[topics/manufacturing/vorbeck|Vorbeck, Jessup MD]] — Vor-ink.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/angstron|Angstron / G3, Dayton]] — McCook Ave.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/conovate|COnovate, Milwaukee]] — graphene monoxide, kg pilot.

Tools, anode-first, media, buyers

  • [[topics/manufacturing/cvd-equipment|CVD Equipment, Central Islip]] — NASDAQ CVV. Tools only.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/talga|Talga, Luleå]] — graphite anode first.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/zentek|Zentek, Guelph]] — ZenGUARD media.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/pacific-urethanes|Pacific Urethanes, Dandenong South]] — PureGRAPH buyer, Sep 2026 PO.

Historical

  • [[topics/manufacturing/versarien|Versarien, Longhope]] — admin 2025–26.
  • [[topics/manufacturing/graphene-frontiers|Graphene Frontiers, Philadelphia]] — OOB Nov 2020.
  • Applied Graphene Materials — Durham ops now under Universal Matter GBR.

item.title: Talga — anode first
item.description:
Evidence: company operations page. Do not file as a graphene mill.

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

What actually runs

Talga Group. EVA plant, Luleå: coated anode qualification, company 50 t/year anode from trial-mined Vittangi ore (page current when retrieved). Commercial Luleå anode refinery is the scale story (24,000 tpa class in slide decks — study/plan until commissioned).

Sweden office: Södra Kungsgatan 5B, 972 35 Luleå. West Perth HQ. Cambridge and Rudolstadt (Germany) R&D addresses on the same deck.

item.title: Thomas Swan (Consett)

item.title: Universal Matter (Burlington / Houston / Redcar)
item.description:

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]] · [[topics/finance/raises-2015-2025]]

What it is

Universal Matter Inc., formed Jul 2019. Process: Rice / Tour Flash Joule Heating to turbostratic graphene from carbon streams (petcoke, ag waste, recycled plastic/rubber in their wording). Genable dispersions for coatings / asphalt / concrete in later copy.

Sites they name

  • Burlington, ON demonstration plant: 1320 Heine Court, Burlington, Ontario L7L 6L9 on a 2024 financing note. 2023 acquisition release: 18,000 sq ft building; nameplate ~1 t/day if fully utilized — company plan, Q3 2023 target in that note.
  • Houston: 900 South Loop West (suite numbers wander in directories).
  • UK: Redcar / Teesside via the AGM purchase — Applied Graphene Materials UK + US ops, US$1.3 million, completion 28 Mar 2023. AGM plc later renamed Universal Matter GBR in trade copy.

Tour flash graphene ≠ a 2004 flake foundry. AGM Genable book sits under this name now.

item.title: Versarien (Longhope) — historical
item.description:
Evidence: Companies House + contemporaneous business press. Not a living mill page.

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]] · [[topics/finance/history]]

What it was

Versarien plc, Longhope Business Park, Monmouth Road, Gloucestershire (Units 1A–D). AIM from 2013. Graphene admixture language included Cementene. Acquired Cambridge Graphene and 2-DTech in the mid-2010s in company/trade copy. Cheltenham Chosen View Road also appears as an office address.

Status (do not list as operating)

  • Jul 2025: company said it could not sell certain UK technology assets; expected Versarien Graphene Ltd into administration; Cambridge Graphene Ltd and 2-DTech Ltd toward voluntary liquidation; Korea ops ceased (Graphene-Info recap of the RNS).
  • Companies House: Versarien Graphene Limited (07475659) — administrator appointed Aug 2025; registered office moved to Leonard Curtis, Manchester.
  • 6 Jan 2026: Versarien plc joint administrators Andrew Knowles and Andrew Poxon (Leonard Curtis). Shares had been suspended. Remaining assets in that notice: patents/trademarks plus shareholdings in Total Carbide Ltd and Gnanomat SL, described as still trading solvent.

File here as history until a buyer of the graphene kit files a new operating address.

item.title: Zentek (Guelph)
item.description:
Evidence: company contact page. Filtration SKU ≠ graphene tonnes.

Parent: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

Sites

Zentek Ltd. Contact: 1123 York Rd, Guelph, Ontario N1E 6Z1. Company text: ZenGUARD production facility in Guelph. Other directories list Thunder Bay (1205 Amber Dr) and further Guelph civic addresses — confirm ship-from on an order.

What it is

ISO 13485 IP shop in their wording: filtration (ZenGUARD on masks/HVAC), biosciences, critical minerals, aptamers. Graphene is an ingredient in a media, not the product name on a tote. Do not file as a powder champion.
